<br>
<strong>为什么通过uefi更新</strong>？<br>
<br>
windows或PE下通过nvmupdatew64e.exe或EEUPDATEW64e.exe都会卡进度走不下去<br>
<br>
------------------------------------------------------<br>
<br>
<strong>工具地址</strong><br>
<br>
蓝奏云：https://wwbbp.lanzouu.com/imXgg3eo68kb 密码:fpjn<br>
<br>
百度云：ttps://pan.baidu.com/s/1-PGP7nf40gwlS3DO1gI2gw?pwd=a3m9 提取码: a3m9<br>
<br>
123云盘：https://www.123865.com/s/J9VeVv-n8sVh 提取码：xc1E<br>
<br>
------------------------------------------------------<br>
<br>
<strong>怎么查看当前网卡版本</strong><br>
<br>
windows系统<br>
<br>
第一次使用请先在带有管理员权限的cmd或powershell中执行install.bat以安装Tools SDK驱动<br>
<br>
<strong>方法一：使用EEUPDATEW64e.exe</strong><br>
<br>
<strong><font color="#4169e1">.\EEUPDATEW64e.exe /ALL /EEPROMVER</font></strong><br>
<br>
<img id="aimg_TSKtd" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/4691cbqmph.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/4691cbqmph.png"><br>
<br>
<strong>方法二：使用nvmupdatew64e.exe<br>
</strong><br>
<font color="#4169e1"><strong>./nvmupdatew64e.exe -i -l<br>
</strong></font><br>
<img id="aimg_mbLgz" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/zo2d2hwkyx.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/zo2d2hwkyx.png"><br>
<br>
------------------------------------------------------<br>
<br>
uefi shell<br>
<br>
找一个U盘格式化成FAT32，将压缩包所有文件解压后放置到根目录。<br>
<br>
开机按F7 上下选择Built-in EFI Shell UEFI回车进入<br>
<br>
<img id="aimg_m797A" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/wnn1l2wdor.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/wnn1l2wdor.jpg"><br>
<br>
如果你手残按不出来，建议按F1修改启动项，按的出就别操作bios了<br>
<br>
开机按F1进入bios，进入boot选项修改 第一启动项为[UEFI AP:UEFI:Built-in EFI Shell]，进入Save &amp; Exit保存并重启电脑即可<br>
<br>
<img id="aimg_KnCU6" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/3xuy7gfkcu.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/3xuy7gfkcu.png"><br>
<br>
进入shell后屏幕会打印FSX的硬盘序号，不知道哪个是U盘就一个一个试试，<br>
<br>
输入<strong><font color="#4169e1">FS0: </font></strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;回车(注意带冒号)<br>
<br>
输入<strong><font color="#4169e1">dir&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></strong>回车查看文件是不是U盘<br>
<br>
<img id="aimg_i0313" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/qxaf9osk9n.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/qxaf9osk9n.png"><br>
<br>
我这里是FS0，顺序和插的usb口有关<br>
<br>
<img id="aimg_k9hxg" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/imcbbrif8d.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/imcbbrif8d.png"><br>
<br>
输入命令<strong><font color="#4169e1">nvmupdate64e.efi -i -l</font></strong> 回车即可输出网卡固件版本，按page up和page down滚动屏幕<br>
<br>
<img id="aimg_o2O8a" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/e7i1e8dy4l.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/e7i1e8dy4l.png"><br>
<br>
确认你需要升级后再进行下面操作<br>
<br>
------------------------------------------------------<br>
<br>
<strong>修改压缩包配置文件nvmupdate.cfg并升级<br>
</strong><br>
按照下图对应将cfg文件修改为你的网卡配置<br>
<br>
VENDOR<br>
<br>
DEVICE<br>
<br>
SUBVENDOR<br>
<br>
SUBDEVICE<br>
<br>
NVM IMAGE:（包含FXVL_125C_V_<strong><font color="#ff0000">1</font></strong>MB_2.32.bin和FXVL_125C_V_<strong><font color="#ff0000">2</font></strong>MB_2.32.bin。网卡芯片包含1MB和2MB这2种版本，没有很好的区分方法，建议先使用1MB不行再改成2MB，如果网卡支持PXE驱动则可能为2MB）<br>
<br>
EEPID: 80000425（1MB的2.32版本固定为80000425不需要修改，<strong><font color="#ff0000">2MB版请修改成80000422</font></strong>，如果后续有更新固件则修改为新固件版本号）<br>
<br>
REPLACES: （<font color="#ff0000"><strong>替换成你网卡的ETrackId</strong></font>，例如图中是80000290）<br>
<br>
<img id="aimg_nSvnG" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/xgii3x6gg0.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/xgii3x6gg0.png"><br>
<br>
以上操作完后可以按照上面的教程进入uefi shell。<br>
<br>
执行<strong><font color="#4169e1">nvmupdate64e.efi -b -l nvm.log -m </font><font color="#ff0000">A8B8E006DC57 </font><font color="#4169e1">-u -c nvmupdate.cfg</font></strong><br>
<br>
注意红色为网卡mac地址，有几个网口就需要修改地址后执行几次<br>
<br>
<img id="aimg_wC3g1" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/lt9208317o.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img-cdn.lusyoe.com/images/p991547436/2025/12/27/lt9208317o.png"><br>
等待几秒执行完成后（怎么判断执行完成？如上图跳出了新的FS2:，一般执行不会超过1分钟），执行命令：<br>
<br>
<strong><font color="#4169e1">cat nvm.log&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>
</font></strong><br>
如果最后一行出现 A reboot is required to complete the update process. 则表示升级成功，如果出现error之类的 查看提示自行处理。<br>
<br>
至此升级完成，关闭电脑并断开电源后重新开机。<br>
<br>
------------------------------------------------------<br>
<br>
备用方案<br>
<br>
<font color="#00bfff">windows下直接升级<br>
</font><br>
先备份，x指的是序号，执行<strong><font color="#4169e1">EEUPDATEW64e.exe /ALL /EEPROMVER</font></strong> 会显示列表，NIC列就是序号<br>
<br>
<strong><font color="#4169e1">备份： EEUPDATEW64e.exe /NIC=</font><font color="#ff0000">x</font><font color="#4169e1"> /dump<br>
<br>
升级： EEUPDATEW64e.exe /nic=</font><font color="#ff0000">x</font><font color="#4169e1"> /d FXVL_125C_V_</font><font color="#ff0000">1</font><font color="#4169e1">MB_2.32.bin</font></strong><br>
<br>
<font color="#00bfff">linux下直接升级</font>：使用 nvmupdate64e linux<br>
<br>
<font color="#00bfff">freedos下直接升级</font>：使用 nvmupdate64e freedos<br>
<br>
<font color="#00bfff">esxi下直接升级</font>：使用 nvmupdate64e_1.43.28.0-800.20613240 esxi.zip<br>
<br>
其他系统请自行尝试，超过1分钟没响应就是更新失败，请使用uefi shell更新<br>
<br>
